description: Reference carry: rank 20 team named in turn 0; follow-ups say 'they'.

turns.query: Who came last in the 2021-2022 Premier League?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_team FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2021-2022' AND tss_rank = 20;

turns.query: And how many points did they finish on?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_points FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2021-2022' AND tss_rank = 20;

turns.query: And how many matches did they win?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_wins FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2021-2022' AND tss_rank = 20;
